outcome.answer: The supplied papers address regional language use on social media in a few related ways, mainly through (1) building or using dialect/regional-variety resources, and (2) analyzing place- and region-linked language patterns in online communities. For example, one thesis studies geographic dialect alignment using place-informed New Zealand Reddit communities, analyzing how users associate language with place and how semantic variation appears across place-based communities [4]. Another paper studies polarization in Bangladeshi social media discourse by analyzing Bengali comments (public vs private university stance) with labeled data and multiple modeling approaches [7].
